title: The Cave Temple
text: On an island in the harbor, carved gods fill a cave temple. A priest sits alone with a lamp.

pass.text: The priest blesses you, and tells you to hurry.

fail.text: In the lamplight, one of the carvings has too many eyes.

title: The Mill Strike
text: The cotton mills are on strike. The workers say the night shift is disappearing.

pass.text: The union leaders trust you. They share what they know and take up a collection for your work.

fail.text: The police charge the crowd, and you are caught in the middle.

title: The Astrologer
text: An astrologer in a rooftop office says the stars have been wrong since spring.

pass.text: Her charts show where the next door will open.

fail.text: Her reading is vague, but one line stays with you.

else.text: She shrugs. The stars will still be wrong tomorrow.

title: The Physician
text: A physician in a quiet courtyard treats you with oils, herbs, and long silences.
